selection.summary: OCI storage backend config fixes: added bundles_directory and poll_interval (default 30s) to storage.oci in config/flipt.schema.cue and config/flipt.schema.json; added PollInterval field and store.oci.poll_interval viper default in internal/config/storage.go (OCI struct, defaults case). Invalid repository validation already existed: StorageConfig.validate() (h14/h19) returns "oci storage repository must be specified" and registry.ParseReference error "validating OCI configuration: invalid reference: missing repository", covered by config_test.go cases (h21/h25/h26) and testdata oci_provided.yml (h9).
